summary: Verified new POST /api/li-search/message/script endpoint and E2E clipboard-based send flow. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed (script generation with recipients+message, empty recipients -> 400, empty message -> 400, missing both -> 400, backtick/${} escaping, /api/health healthy, /api/li-search/posts returns >=20). Script string contains all recipient names (TEST_Msg1/2/3), public_ids, profile URLs, and the message text baked-in as expected. Frontend E2E: seeded 3 test connections, logged into agent gate (Agent@2024!), Messaging tab loaded, search filter shows 3 test cards, 'Select All' correctly selects all 3 (regression from iter 10 fix confirmed — 3 selected, all 3 chips render in 'Sending to' preview). Send button label reads 'Send to 3 Connections via LinkedIn'. Click triggers POST /message/script, script (3369 chars) is auto-copied to clipboard (verified via navigator.clipboard.readText() — contains LinkedIn Auto-Message Script header, all 3 recipient names, all 3 profile URLs, and the exact message text). Success toast reads exactly: 'Auto-send script copied to clipboard! Paste it in LinkedIn's console (F12 → Console → allow pasting → Ctrl+V → Enter)'. Expandable 'View/Copy Script' details opens a readonly textarea with the same script string. All 3 test connections cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: linkedin_search.py is now ~1602 lines — carryover modularization request from iter 8/9/10 still open. Consider splitting into cookie.py, search.py, connections.py, messaging.py.

The /api/li-search/message/script endpoint accepts an untyped dict (data: dict) — recommend using a Pydantic ScriptRequest model (recipients: List[Dict], message: str) for consistent validation/error responses.
React key warnings (from iter 10 note) may still occur elsewhere — Messaging tab keys now use public_id, which is correct.
